task.title: P6-013: Report initial_value() ignoring during_hydration() upstream to leptos-rs
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 3 — Leverage: fixes that retire a whole class). Original id: P6-013. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/ui-work-loop.md.

**Report `initial_value()` ignoring `during_hydration()` upstream to leptos-rs — it is the root cause of the `/my` empty-state bug and it has never actually been filed.** Verified 2026-07-30, and **the entry's own claims needed two corrections**: (1) it has **not** been reported upstream — "already filed" meant filed in this backlog (`app-ui.md:330`), and there are zero `leptos-rs/leptos` references anywhere in `specs/` or `.github/`; (2) the version cites are wrong — `Cargo.lock` pins **leptos 0.8.14** and **hydration_context 0.3.0**, not the 0.8.20/0.3.1 the entry names. The mechanism is confirmed at the corrected coordinates: `leptos_server-0.8.6/src/resource.rs:399-405` calls `shared_context.read_data(id)` for **every** `Resource::new` with no time guard, and `hydration_context-0.3.0/src/hydrate.rs:132` is a bare non-consuming `__RESOLVED_RESOURCES[id]` read; if it decodes, the fetcher never runs. `during_hydration()`/`hydration_complete()` both exist and are maintained (`hydrate.rs:143-150`, `leptos-0.8.14/src/mount.rs:97` and `:156`) — `initial_value` simply ignores them, so an `SsrMode::Async` page's second and third serialization passes stay in the array as landmines for resources created during client-side navigation. **`leptos_server-0.8.7`'s `initial_value` is byte-identical, so a version bump is not a fix.** Both general app-side fixes were investigated and rejected as unsafe: clearing `__RESOLVED_RESOURCES` at hydration-complete **races streaming** (late chunks write into the same array), and clearing on navigation is **too late** (Effects run after the new route's components are built). There is no keyed or opt-out `Resource` constructor. **Correct the version cites in the body before filing.** Do not let `P6-002` wait on this — upstream landing is outside this repo's control.
